{#- The dark site footer, shared by the community pages and the conference pages from 2026 on (conference/base.html sets conference_footer). Both share a layout, styled by _static/conf/scss/site-footer.scss, that lines up with the page's content: the wide community column or the narrower conference one. What goes in it follows each footer's job: - Community pages: join the community, through Slack and the newsletter. - Conference pages: say which event this is and link its reference pages, then lead to the community that runs it. The event's current asks (tickets, sponsoring, videos once it's over) are already right above, in the config's bottom buttons and the sponsors band, so they aren't repeated here. Conference sites stay up for years, so nothing in it assumes the event is still ahead. -#} {%- macro conf_link(page) -%} {{ pathto('conf/' ~ shortcode ~ '/' ~ year_str ~ '/' ~ page) }} {%- endmacro %}
